Circus (-93 to -63) stays clear of the loop join at -56. Records (-400 to -370) stays clear of Market Street. Comet (-703 to -673) stays clear of Comet Row.

S1, west to east: Gardens x -160, Crown Circus 90, Harbour 290, Skyport 530. Gaps are 250, 200 and 240 m (rule: 200–500). All 50 m platforms are on the straight trunk; Skyport ends at x 555, short of the loop at 560. Gardens stays on the Records Axis (x -160). Skyport fronts the pier because it stands over the water.
Interchange: T1/circus (0,-78) and S1/circus (90,0) are 119 m apart, inside the 150 m limit. The two lines join at this one pair, so the network is connected (N-C1).

Every entrance fronts a road or foot path whose centreline is under 6 m away: the Boulevard, the Circus Road median, the Crown Parade mall and the Skyport Pier. All of it is walkable public space (W-2/W-3).

N-R1 fails, and no stop position on these lines can fix it. All four sit about 260 m east or west of the Boulevard, and S1 runs at z 0, far to the north. Tram spacing (at least 300 m) and the interchange (circus stop no further south than about -150) leave no better positions.
